street.summary: Four houses had a published call standing on 30-Sep-2026, all BUY: ICICI Securities institutional Rs 580 (29-May), ICICI Direct Rs 625 (29-Jul, reiterated 10-Aug), Anand Rathi Rs 650 (20-Jul) and Elara Rs 605 (last seen 4/9-Apr). Every disclosed method is P/E on FY28E earnings (36x-45x); ICICI Securities' initiation blended P/E with EV/EBITDA. Only ICICI Direct updated after Q1 results (27-Jul). Anand Rathi's Rs 650 came on 20-Jul, a week BEFORE Q1 results, on the semiconductor thesis; no Anand Rathi Q1 note was found. No calls dated Aug-Sep 2026 other than ICICI Direct's 10-Aug reiteration.

Key risk: SCC uses a wholly owned vehicle and SCIL earns only rent; full glyphosate ban (~14-15% of FY26 revenue).

guidanceAndOutlook.productLaunches: Topgrain (biostimulant, from SCC group) and Helibax (pyridalyl + emamectin) on track for launch in Q2FY27; FY26 launches Lentigo and Excalia Max beat internal targets (ICICI Direct); 3-4 SCC products in the launch pipeline; products launched in the last 3 years = 8% of domestic revenue.
guidanceAndOutlook.boardChanges: From 1-Sep-2026: Dr Suresh Ramachandran MD; Chetan Shah's MD term ends 31-Aug and he becomes Non-Executive Non-Independent Director, to be considered for Chairman by the Board; Chairman Mukul Asher, ED Sushil Marfatia and NED Ninad Gupte leave on 31-Aug; N. Sivaraman re-appointed ID to 31-Aug-2029; Anand Mohan Tiwari ID from 31-Aug-2026. Kunal Mittal EVP heads finance, planning, procurement, business development (new segments) and manufacturing.
guidanceAndOutlook.standingGuidanceFromMay2026Call: Supply-chain planning on a normal kharif; flagged risks: monsoon (IMD forecast 92% of LPA), El Nino, fertiliser availability; ~55% of net sown area irrigated; CSM sales to parent to be held at ~Rs 110-140 cr in FY27, incremental from FY28-29 as projects commission; roughly one new Dahej project a year; royalty to parent on 2-3 products capped at Rs 2 cr; margins described as sustainable; accumulated cash to fund parent-linked capex; one more product awaiting registration; biologicals ~8-10% of revenue; India in SCC's tier-1 early-trial group with 2 molecules in Indian trials.
guidanceAndOutlook.semiconductor: ICICI Direct (29-Jul): parent indicated plans to commercialise high-purity semiconductor chemicals in India; discussions with government agencies and customers ongoing jointly with SCIL. May-2026 call: 'hopefully, very soon, you may officially hear from us'.
